entry.note: Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1093/qmath/20.1.235) and primary citations in Birman-Ko-Lee (1998) and Dehornoy et al. (2015).

relevance.rationale: Foundational paper introducing the positive braid monoid B_n^+, the fundamental half-twist Delta, and canonical normal-form stepping solving the braid word and conjugacy problems.

keyResults.statement: B_n^+ embeds in B_n, every braid admits a canonical Delta^k positive decomposition, and summit sets give a finite decidable invariant of conjugacy.
keyResults.useForFolio: Grounds positive-monoid normal-form stepping and conjugacy invariants on B_n.
